name: GBLIN Protocol
description: The Machine Reserve: permissionless, self-defending reserve asset for AI-agent treasuries on Base. Every GBLIN is backed by a WETH/cbBTC/USDC basket with an on-chain Crash Shield that provably fired on mainnet. Risk policy is public code; risk state is a signed observable, not an opinion. In-kind redemption anytime.

endpoints.mcpPrompts: risk_gate, seal_and_verify (POST prompts/list on the hosted MCP)
endpoints.mcpAudit: https://gblin-mcp.gblin-mcp-worker.workers.dev/meta (GET-only mirror of tools, resources and prompts)

skills.name: Read treasury state
skills.description: NAV, basket composition and Crash Shield status.

skills.name: Quote buy/sell
skills.description: USDC/ETH to GBLIN quote with fees and slippage.

skills.name: JIT redemption
skills.description: Two-step GBLIN to USDC calldata to settle x402 invoices.

skills.name: Market risk regime
skills.note: The unsigned regime read is free (hosted MCP tool risk.regime and the stdio package). The paid item is the signed attestation, 0.003 USDC.

skills.name: Signed risk attestation
skills.description: EIP-712 signed proof-of-diligence, verifiable offline in one step — no trust in the server required. Bought daily by a third-party ERC-8004 agent as a pinned input of its published decision rule until 16 Aug 2026; current status on gblin.digital/receipts. Free integration sample at /api/x402/attestation-sample.

attestation.note: Attestations are signed by this address. Pin it: a valid signature that recovers to a DIFFERENT address is not ours. If it is ever rotated, the new address is published here and in llms.txt with the rotation date, and the old one is listed as retired.
